decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of speakers from premium brands to budget alternatives. The Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1 is highly rated but priced very high at $279. The Sony SRS-RA3000 offers interesting 360-degree audio, but multiple reviews cited frustrations with the required app. The JBL Charge 4 is a reliable mid-range option, but since it is a 'Renewed' unit, I have concerns about the long-term battery health. While the INSMY models offer good value for money, I was ultimately looking for a brand-new, high-performance portable speaker from a top-tier brand that fits within a $100-$150 budget. Since the current selection features either very expensive high-end units, renewed older models, or budget brands, I have decided to wait for a better selection.
